messages.subject: Problem when running RSWAT: "Error in { : task 1 failed - 'cannot open the connection'"
parts:
Hi,

I am running RSWAT on unix without the UI as i was unablet to upload my observed datafile in the UI. The model appears to run and it shows that executions are completed, however i get "Error in { : task 1 failed - 'cannot open the connection'". When i look at the TxtInOut_x files, i see that the outputs i need exist and the relevant output is in the correct column: # 9. Output extraction for SWAT+
outputExtraction <- data.frame(
  FileType = c("channel_sd_mon.txt","basin_wb_mon.txt"),
  FileName = c("channel_sd_mon.txt","basin_wb_mon.txt"),
  Column = c("48","15"),
  Reach = c("250","1")
). I initially tried 100 iterations for 20 cores then 20 interations for 10 cores. Both resulted in the same error.

Any advice or guidance would be appreciated a lot.

Thanks
Aimen
